summary: Retested admin origin/auth + settings restore, local session/report durability, Early route behavior, and selective gameplay/unit coverage on public preview.

minor.issue: 6/17 deterministic gameplay unit tests fail (heavy damage, respawn inventory reset, spawn safety spread/cadence, bot combat assertions) and no longer match current runtime behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Early APIs return 503 due external DB2 network block; UI shows load-error state instead of interactive login/settings.

Could not run full authenticated browser gameplay (movement/fire/reload/death/respawn) because production wallet sign-in gate remained locked in automation context (no connected wallet fixture in browser).

action_items: Review/fix or retire stale expectations in backend/tests/test_iteration6_game_unit_focus.py to align with current gameplay/runtime contracts.
Provide a deterministic browser-test auth fixture/provider path to exercise true /play UI flow (useSession + GameRenderer) without bypassing production auth logic.
Infrastructure: allow TCP access to MONGO_URL2/DB_NAME2 for Early DB to clear intentional 503 isolation when needed.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.check_origin currently compares raw request Origin without request-side normalization; trailing-slash request Origin behavior is brittle and should be explicitly normalized or explicitly rejected with documented contract.
Early subsystem correctly isolates failure (503) when secondary DB is unreachable; game API path remains operational.
Frontend production build succeeds but has heavy warning surface (missing RN async-storage resolution + many sourcemap warnings), increasing noise for real regressions.
seed_data_creation: Created test-only paid wallet/session fixture account in test_iteration2_regression_focus.py; cleaned up collections in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed: public admin login/settings works (Origin allowlist fixed), browser admin can set zombie_count=100 + bot_count=3 and restore original settings. Local report idempotency across disconnect/recover passed (no duplicate gold delta on replay of same sequence). Early /early and /early/console routes render; /api/early/* and /api/early/admin/settings return 503 due external DB2 block. Full /play browser gameplay was not executed because wallet-auth remained locked in automation browser.
rca of the issue: Remaining integration blocker is environmental: Early DB (MONGO_URL2) is externally unreachable (TCP27017 blocked), so Early API routes return 503 by design. Separate quality gap: iteration6 unit tests are out-of-sync with present engine/runtime behavior, producing false-negative regression signals until updated to current contracts.
